text.p: Lifeway Foods Inc, which reported slightly lower third-quarter earnings, said it continues to back analysts' earnings estimates of $0.16 per share for the full year.

"We continue to be quite comfortable with street estimates of full-year earnings of $0.16 per share, up 33 percent from last year's record $0.12 per share," said president Michael Smolyansky in a statement.
Smolyansky said third-quarter margins and net income were slightly lower due to an investment to market the company's new fat-free lines and because of higher raw material costs.
"Price increases have been implemented to reflect new material costs, and we are confident that margins will return to normal levels next quarter," he said.
Earlier on Thursday, the marketer of the fermented dairy beverage kefir and drinkable yogurts, reported third-quarter earnings of $0.04 per share compared with $0.05 a year ago.
